name: @hl-bos/football
description: The football domain, as code. Vocabulary (personnel, formations, concepts, coverages, fronts, pressures), situational classification, grading scales, tendency aggregation with an explicit not-enough-data result, and film-search query parsing. Pure and deterministic: no network, no database, no AI provider. Shared by Football FilmStudy AI and, later, the rest of the Venuewise athletics products so they cannot disagree about what 'explosive' means.
